title: Apple Reveals How Secure Exclaves Shield Camera and Microphone Data
description: Apple has detailed its Secure Exclaves architecture designed to isolate camera and microphone data used for ambient sensing from the main operating system on devices such as HomeView and new iPhones. This architecture ensures that sensitive sensor data cannot be accessed or altered by the main OS or apps, with only limited metadata shared under strict conditions. Secure Exclaves run on a formally verified microkernel to enhance security and prevent kernel compromise. The design includes user-visible indicators for sensor activity that the main OS cannot interfere with, enhancing privacy and security.
